image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, grey rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with a distinct reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping dorsal plates. The plates feature intricate wavy patterns in white, brown, and red. The head is at the right end (anterior), appearing blunt and indistinct without visible eyes or tentacles.
